messages:
alex: FYI my docs PR (#2345) accidentally changes the /v1/generate request example to an array. API expects an object. This will break SDK snippets and confuse users. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345

riley: Which field is wrong exactly? payload shape?

alex: The root body currently shows `[{\"prompt\": \"...\"}]` but the canonical schema is an object like `{\"input\": \"...\"}`. Current snippet in the file is:
```json
[{\"prompt\":\"Translate the following:\"}]
```
Should be:
```json
{\"input\":\"Translate the following:\"}
```

marta: cc @samir — our Go/TS SDK snippets pull from these examples. If we keep the array example we'll ship broken client code. We should update examples + add a short migration note for anyone using the older array format.

samir: I'll update the SDK snippet once docs land. Can you add a one-liner in the docs: "Note: previous examples used an array body; use {\"input\":...} now"? :+1:

riley: Also the response example in the same doc has `outputs` as a single string currently which doesn't match the response schema. Right now it shows:
```json
{\"id\":\"gen_123\",\"outputs\":\"ok\"}
```
Should be:
```json
{\"id\":\"gen_123\",\"outputs\":[{\"text\":\"ok\"}]}
```

alex: I'll push a small docs-only PR with the corrected request + response examples and update the Python/JS snippets under `snippets/`. Want to coordinate so SDK doesn't change the same snippet at the same time.

marta: Plan: alex updates docs, samir updates SDK snippets after docs merge, riley verifies response shape, then I will do a quick sanity merge. Target: land by EOD. Ping me when your PR is ready for review.

docsbot: lint-report: examples/lint failed on docs/generate.md:42 — "response shape mismatch". See CI details: https://ci.redwood/linters/9876

samir: A note: will not change streaming param names. We standardized on `max_new_tokens` for all examples (not `maxTokens`). Please keep that naming in the update.

alex: Understood. I'm editing `docs/generate.md` and `snippets/js/generate.example.ts` now. Will keep `max_new_tokens` intact. Pushing in ~10m.

riley: Also update the OpenAPI example JSON under `openapi/examples/generate.json` — the site pulls that into the API ref.

marta: Added a mini-checklist for the PR description: update examples (req/resp), update openapi example, update snippet files, add migration note, run `yarn docs:build` and smoke-check the rendered page.

alex: Done — pushed at 1719999120: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2346. Changed array -> object, fixed response `outputs` to array, kept `max_new_tokens`.

samir: I'll branch off after you merge and open sdk PR referencing the docs commit hash.

riley: Quick nit: in the JS snippet change `prompt` -> `input` in the example, but keep the function param named `promptText` since that's internal name we use in examples.

marta: LGTM after the nit. Merging now.

alex: Merged. Thanks everyone. Closing follow-up ticket #567.
